strategic_choice: Prefer six real role changes over the five minimum; retain both Noise Marine printed cascade and Nalfeshnee exile-casting copies rather than deleting two Warhammer engines to manufacture seven. Compared with alternate six Exalted Flamer recursion, Sheoldred gives a distinct on-turn Wheel/Windfall mass life-loss scaling engine, lower risk of needing to survive to next upkeep once assembled, but raises the B/B and Ponder-cut issue. This is a reasoned candidate, NOT a proof of win rate or completed new M6 I/J.

candidate_judgments.because: Creates direct paid repeated creature-entry damage with protected Birgi+Ignus+Nightscape and Lost Spawn ETBs; loses Thermo instant/sorc tap-untap threshold access.

At two mana and when survived to first main, enables prior-to-hand-cast X3 with 3 opponents without random target/library or any mana spent on a stolen card; loses four-mana 40K random exile theft and owner-MV burn.

Same early 1R broad noncreature red pinger, optional payable Offspring 2 makes a second autonomous pinger and adds two creature-entry events with Impact; lower original creature toughness 2 vs 3, additional mana investment before benefiting.

At 4MV copy Abaddon for a second independent commander cascade grant on every qualifying hand spell, while retaining original Abaddon through Sakashima legend-rule text; gives up Keeper's 6MV independent nonhand-cast mana-value-damage Warhammer engine and needs Abaddon available on entry.

Real land utility: on-demand own-turn X3 for 1BR and tap, including under Rule of Law, untapped BR selection and rare larger board-wipe alternative; costs life to tap for color, loses basic Mountain fetch/protection and is not a free cosmetic slot.

At 4MV with BB, each fully resolving Wheel of Fortune draws seven per opponent and induces X42 later own-turn opponent life loss (X84 with Bloodletter), interacting with current Orcish Bowmasters and Wheel/Windfall; cuts cheap card selection and has conditional high-ceiling opponent-response vulnerability.

other_material_dispositions.reason: 40K four-mana recursion can be superior in grindier tables and retains flavor, but random upkeep retrieval and 1-point spell pings are less decisive than a protected own-turn Sheoldred wheel threshold.
Cheaper unconditional colorless upkeep threshold and Bowmasters/Wheel draw package, but gifts three opponents cards and Wheel incidental loss is half Sheoldred's at X21 versus X42.
Stronger for repeated red 1-damage pings than Solphim in alternate mage-dense shell, but current Flame Rift/Boltwave and nonred sources favor broader Solphim.
Cost6 recurrent printed single cascade competes poorly with Noise Marine cost5 direct Sonic Blaster and Call Forth double cascade.
3 generic and tap paid to next noncreature cascade after four-mana body slows plan relative to commander grant and Wild-Magic.
ENTERS TAPPED at 3MV so no imagined immediate mana/loss threshold; worse than T2 Talisman tempo.

A seventh addition requiring removal of Noise Marine is rejected on printed cascade and direct Sonic Blaster value; neither stopping at six nor achieving five establishes proof of global optimum.
